title: Structure-sheaf maps and derived global sections
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], let D(O_X) be its unbounded derived category [def-pc-derived-category], put A=Γ(X,O_X), and let RΓ:D(O_X)→D(A) be the unbounded right derived functor of the module-valued global-sections functor [def-sc-ringed-space-module-cohomology, def-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-direct-image]. Let A[0] denote the free rank-one A-module placed in degree zero and O_X[0] the degree-zero structure sheaf. There is a family of additive equivalences a_E:Hom_D(O_X)(O_X[0],E) ≃+ Hom_D(A)(A[0],RΓ(E)), natural in every E: a_E'(g≫f)=a_E(g)≫RΓ(f) for every f:E→E' and g:O_X[0]→E. There is no quasi-coherence, boundedness, quasi-compactness, or separatedness assumption.

proof.text: Use lem-pc-structure-sheaf-homotopy-global-sections for the additive, natural evaluation-at-one equivalences in the homotopy category. The single complex A[0] is strictly at most zero; its only nonzero term is the free rank-one projective A-module, and its other terms are zero and therefore projective. Mathlib CochainComplex.isKProjective_of_projective gives K-projectivity, and CochainComplex.IsKProjective.Qh_map_bijective upgrades its homotopy maps to derived maps. Use quotientCompQhIso to identify the localized single complexes with the stated singleFunctor objects.

Every derived object admits a K-injective representative, by prop-pur-kinjective-resolutions-exist and DerivedCategory.exists_iso_Q_obj_of_isKInjective. The localization map on homotopy maps into such a representative is bijective by lem-weil-pbc-kinjective-hom-derived. The right-derived-functor unit is an isomorphism on K-injectives, by def-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-direct-image and the source right-derived-functor API. Compose the inverse localization equivalence, evaluation at one, the module localization equivalence, and this unit isomorphism.

Choose K-injective representatives J_E and isomorphisms i_E:E to Qh(J_E). Transport the preceding additive equivalence along i_E and its image under RΓ. For f:E to Eprime, lift i_E inverse composed with f composed with i_Eprime to a homotopy morphism h, using bijectivity into the K-injective target. If k represents g, functoriality and injectivity of localization show that k composed with h represents g composed with f. Evaluation-at-one naturality and naturality of the right-derived-functor unit give the desired equation. Cancel the representative isomorphisms using their inverse identities and functoriality. This is the proved private categorical lemma descendHomEquiv; no naturality is postponed.

theorem derivedStructureSheaf_globalSections_hom (X : Scheme.{u})
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))] :
    letI := HasDerivedCategory.standard
      (ModuleCat.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).obj.obj (op ⊤)))
    let RΓ := (RingedSpace.globalSectionsFunctor X.toRingedSpace).rightDerivedFunctor
    let A₀ := (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
      (ModuleCat.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).obj.obj (op ⊤))) 0).obj
        (ModuleCat.of ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).obj.obj (op ⊤))
          ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).obj.obj (op ⊤)))
    ∃ e : ∀ E : schemeDerivedCategory X,
      (((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
        (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) 0).obj
          (SheafOfModules.unit (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))) ⟶ E) ≃+
        (A₀ ⟶ RΓ.obj E),
      ∀ (E E' : schemeDerivedCategory X) (f : E ⟶ E') (g :
        (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
          (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) 0).obj
            (SheafOfModules.unit (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) ⟶ E),
        e E' (g ≫ f) = e E g ≫ RΓ.map f
